item.title: Suspect shot, killed by deputies near Galt
item.description: A person was shot and killed by deputies near Galt Friday morning. It happened around 8 a.m. near the 8100 block of New Hope Road near Galt in south Sacramento County, deputies said.

item.title: Accused child molester who once fled to Mexico released on bond
item.description: A former fugitive who once fled from Sacramento to Mexico to avoid child sexual assault charges has been released on bail.

item.title: Yuba City man shot by police was naked, carrying shovel
item.description: The man shot Thursday by a Yuba City officer was "completely nude" and carrying a shovel, police say. The Yuba City Police Department released new information about the shooting Friday.

item.title: Serial embezzler gets 12 years for stealing $1.4M from Lake Tahoe company
item.description: A Nevada woman who defrauded a Lake Tahoe construction company out of $1.4 million and used the money to buy houses, cars and even a horse was sentenced to more than 12 years in prison.

item.title: Daniel Serafini sentenced to life in prison for 2021 shooting
